reason: A DSH plugin health-check utility that statically inspects plugins, validates configuration and dependencies, tests isolated startup, and offers repair or rollback actions.

summaries.zh: 用于检查 DSH 插件的文件、依赖和配置，并通过隔离试跑验证插件启动情况，提供修复与回滚操作。
summaries.en: Checks DSH plugin files, dependencies, and configuration, validates startup through isolated runs, and provides repair and rollback actions.

capabilities: Reads installed plugin files and configuration
Performs static dependency, package, and suspicious-pattern checks
Runs an isolated subprocess boot test for enabled plugins
Writes plugin or profile configuration changes for repairs and rollback
